original_stop_rule: three consecutive H2-approved rounds with zero new non-redundant English term families and zero new canonical indicator families
reason: The project owner directed round 12 to be the terminal search-frame discovery round because the expected marginal information gain of further deterministic batches was judged too small for the execution cost.
reporting_requirement: Report this as a retrospective protocol deviation and retain the computed round-12 endpoint counts. Do not describe the stopping result as dual-zero unless the adjudicated database counts are in fact both zero.
